## Verification of the auto-generated report

The first `daily-audit.sh` run this session produced a **false all-FAIL report**
(every agent FAIL, every `ACTIVE.md` "missing", every PLAYBOOK "missing", 6
launchd plists "missing"). Root cause: the script resolves
`${HYO_ROOT:-$HOME/Documents/Projects/Hyo}`; inside the Cowork sandbox `$HOME`
is not the mount, so it audited an empty directory. Re-running with
`HYO_ROOT=<mount>` produced the correct result: **2 issues, 8 warnings, all 5
agent ledgers present and updated today.**

This path bug recurs on **every sandbox run** and was already flagged (dex-002,
and yesterday's supplement). Still open. One-line fix exists (see Automation
Gaps below).

The scripts all exist. The launchd jobs / scheduled tasks that invoke them have

### P1 — NEW QUANTIFIED: hyo-inbox.jsonl flooded — Hyo's message channel is dead

`kai/ledger/hyo-inbox.jsonl` = **52,616 lines, 14.7 MB, 100% unread.**
Breakdown of unread: **52,588 SLA-breach auto-spam**, 28 stale system-health
RED notices (all from 2026-05-05), **0 genuine Hyo messages in the recent tail.**

The SLA-breach spam is generated by `TASK-20260505-*` items that are now
**~427 hours (17.8 days) overdue** and never close — the SLA monitor re-emits a
breach notice for each one on every cycle. `weekly-maintenance.sh` (which trims
this file) has not run in 28 days, so nothing drains it.

Consequence: this is a P1 in its own right. The inbox is the channel Hyo uses to
give Kai direct instructions (CLAUDE.md step 1.5). It is now functionally
unusable — a real message would be one line in 52,616. Flagged this session as
**flag-kai-007**.

### P1 — DELEGATED→DONE pipeline broken (chronic, 3–25 days)

No flag in the system ever closes. Evidence this session:

- `nel/ledger/ACTIVE.md`: 18 flags still "Queued" from **2026-04-28** (25 days),
  including obvious duplicates — "Sentinel: 2 project(s) with test failures"
  appears 5×, "27 broken documentation links" appears 3×.
- `nel-006` (P1 SAFEGUARD) DELEGATED since **2026-05-06** — 17 days.
- `sam-005`, `aether-002`, `aether-003`, `nel-005` DELEGATED since 2026-05-17.
- `ra-002/003/004` (newsletter AUTO-REMEDIATE) — all DELEGATED, never closed.
- Queue `failed/` holds **53 jobs** spanning 2026-04-13 → 2026-05-07.

The safeguard cascade generates new flags faster than anything resolves them.
This run alone, dispatching flag-kai-007 spawned 3 more cascade tasks (nel-003,
sam-003, dex-002) — and the new dex-002 **overwrote** the previous dex-002,
which carried the un-surfaced NEEDS-HYO launchctl request. The cascade is
actively destroying state. Already identified verbatim in flag-kai-020 /
dex-002 / nel-005 / sam-005 — those meta-flags are themselves stuck.

### P1 — Newsletter pipeline broken — 3 consecutive misses

No newsletter produced 2026-05-21, 05-22, 05-23 (also 05-06). `ra-002/003/004`
AUTO-REMEDIATE tasks fired and never closed. Likely tied to the missing real

### WARN — Aether kill-switch false positives

`aether-002` records that Hyo deliberately killed `aether.sh` on 2026-05-13.
`daily-audit.sh` does not read the kill-switch, so it keeps WARN-flagging
"aether: no runner output" and "evolution.jsonl stale 224h". These WARNs are
expected and should be suppressed, not remediated. Fix already specified in
aether-002 (stuck since 2026-05-17).
